blocks.text: THE FUTURE ALIGNMENT— ‘‘The 80’s have been perilous and chaotic and will step up momentum in 1987-90. — Later changes in leadership will bring a complete new vision to the U.S.A. Dramatic and powerful social and economic changes are coming! — But beyond this in the 90’s it will be worldwide; not only in those conditions but it will be structural changes!’’ — ‘‘New dimensions in every way that people think and do, work, pleasure and etc. A regular fantasy world, an atmosphere of make believe leading to false worship! . . . Add this to an alcohol/drug related society and you have the making of a delusion of doom!’’ — ‘‘People’s minds will totally change and will be caught up into a euphorium of global thinking! — A massive deception, an electronic global family enslaved by a master of subtlety, a world leader! — It seems we are crossing a bridge of time . . . a tunnel into the future, the hand-writing is on the wall!’’ — ‘‘I foresee an atomic sword hanging over every nation like a black cloud, a harbinger of doom! — Frightened mankind will hover together like the beast of the field! — Evidently this last statement has to do with the threat of destruction upon the world and is partly and actually what causes them to come under one world system grasping for world peace! — And peace will finally come for a while (anti-christ 7 year peace covenant) — but it will only delay the final holocaust momentarily!’’ . . . ‘‘In the vision of prophecy Armageddon still looms in a fiery halo of disaster over the Middle East spreading world-wide!’’

THE FUTURE CONTINUING— ‘‘According to prophecy we will have a new economy, a new social and political system, a new religion that blends all cults and false religions together! A definite thrust towards a new world order is being planned right now in various nations; and within a very short period of time this will pave the way for a world dictator!’’ — ‘‘The other day on the News some well-known economists claimed the 1990’s will usher in a global collapse involving most phases of the governments! — We know there will be a world-wide food shortage and depression later in the age and is one more reason why mankind unites in the wrong system taking the mark!’’ (Rev. chap. 6:5-8 — Rev. 11:6) — ‘‘But mankind will be plagued by economic and other problems even before this time . . . as the Scripts reveal!’’ — “Inflation is creeping now and once out of hand again coupled with the debt (trillions) owed by the U.S.A. is evidently what causes this nation to do future things it never would have thought of before! — And becoming partners with the dragon himself!’’
THE DIMENSIONAL FUTURE— ‘‘As we spoke of before concerning political and religious, economic systems will be tied to super computers that will master-mind the world economy! Controlling

. it will command the people who buy, work and sell!’’ — ‘‘Do you know that the Stock Market is now almost all run by computers? — Who, they say, give the actual buying and selling signals! — In other words the Market can rise to new heights and then fall like lightning giving the bigger investor (tied to computers) the advantage over the small individual buyer!’’ — Rev. chap. 18, “‘reveals a Commercial Market in the future that seemingly works richly well for all who are involved in it, until it is destroyed! (verses 8-12) — And Sor the above to take place it evidently reveals the electronic computers will spread into many homes and businesses! — For the Market places will be controlled by electronic impulses!’’

THE NEW WAVE FUTURE— ‘“‘Already they are predicting the normal credit cards people have now will be obsolete! — It is claimed that the new debit card is the coming thing!’’ — ‘‘This seems to tie into a prophecy that I gave many years ago concerning what I said seemed to be electronic money that was given instantly by the transferring of a card into a counter machine, etc.!’’ — ‘‘Finally a mark will follow all of these new schemes of mankind! — We are headed for a world-wide centralized computer base! . . . Men are trying to create a cashless society so that it can be controlled at a central point!’’ (Rev. 13:13-16)

PROPHECY CONTINUING— ‘‘Let us see what the newer computers are being developed to do! . . . They can talk, diagnose illness, counsel with people, serve as babysitters and translate foreign languages!’ — ‘The Common Market countries, a major part of the ‘revived Roman Empire’ are using computers to break down the language barriers! In the near distant future it will be possible for all languages to talk to one another! In other words your computer will be able to translate instantly what someone speaking in another language is saying!’’ — “The newer bio-computers man brags, will solve the world’s unemployment, energy shortages, medical costs, problems that come with old age, industrial inefficiency, food shortages and money crises!’’

PROPHECY IN THE NEW WORLD APPROACHING— ‘‘Scientists now are talking in terms of permanent space stations . . . also space cities! Right now our space flights are all controlled by central computers! — Space stations will be controlled in the same manner! — Man also is hurling satellites into the heavens by the thousands! . . . They are preparing a place for space weapons and indeed it is predicted that man will have a space war!’’ — ‘‘In the later light dimensional computers it is possible for a computer no bigger than the size of a man’s brain to control the war weapons of one nation or even many nations!’’ — ‘‘Now you must remember that we are looking into the future aways! — The Scriptures predicted that man would build ‘thy nest among the stars’! — Evidently this points to sex or even babies being born in space!’’ (Ohad. 1:4) — ‘‘Since writing this quite awhile back, we see that now they are sending some women into space with men!... Isn’t prophecy amazing!’’ — ‘‘They are building these space stations, and just like a bird builds it’s nest, they are taking it up piece by piece! — And the Bible used the very word . . . nest!’’

TECHNOLOGY AND BABYLON FUTURE— ‘‘In the developing new age coming — both Mystery Babylon (Rev. 17) and Commercial Babylon will be tied to electronic computers controlling the religious and commercial element! Now Mystery Babylon is all the false churches and is the whore that rides the political systems controlling Commercial Babylon! (verse 3) — As Mystery Babylon the mother whore has religious intercourse with the nations deceiving them in false doctrines with a gold cup of wealth in her hand! — Now in Rev. chap 18 we see Commercial Babylon wherein all types of trading takes place through electronic computers even to the prostitution selling of men and women! — Also in many of the large cities a computer listing of prostitutes are well on its way! — Just as in ancient Pagan Rome they did not want ordinary prostitutes, but all the most sensual nympho whores were brought in and listed!’’ — ‘‘So today in the system of great Babylon the same events will take place from its traders from top to bottom, underworld or otherwise!’ . . . “The women and their money controlled electronically! — One of the biggest money industries in the world especially in Paris is prostitution; not only involving girls, but boys! And in Paris as reported in the news the Catholics have provided a ‘special church’ for the prostitutes to receive mass in! — Both Babylons will control by modem technology and electronics! But Mystery Babylon will receive her just rewards from the very beast that she rides! — (For more information read Scroll #132.)

PROPHECY CONTINUING— “‘It is reported now different telephone companies allow customers to buy phone sex from a prostitute girl, who talks back to a client in words that cannot be described here, supposedly bringing him an experience as if she was there in person!”’ — “‘And they now have for later release a phone with a T.V. picture screen wherein they can not only hear her talk, but see the movements!’’ . .. ‘And then later this will lead to a 3 dimensional light, a holographic image that comes into the room for both men and women! — A fantasy dimension as predicted is coming!’’ — ‘‘Much more can be said about this, but it reveals the conditions the world is headed for! — In other words we are seeing the shape of things to come!’’

THE PROPHETIC ALIGNMENT— ‘‘According to Dan. chap. 11 and other Scriptures towards the end of the age there will be four principal power blocks! — The King of the West, (the revived Roman Empire associated to the Middle East and in agreement with the U.S.A. — Next the King of the North, Russia and the communist satellite nations including eastern Europe! — The King of the South, Egypt and the other African nations! — The King of the East, China and the orient nations!’’ — ‘‘These 4 blocks all have their providential purposes in a coming future world empire . . . that we will describe at some later writing!’’ — ‘“What we have given in this Script is a capsule of events soon to take place alerting the Christians to watch and pray and to work in the harvest as never before!’’ — “‘It’s high time to awake, time is short! — Symbolically speaking you might say it is evaporating right before our very eyes! — Jesus return is getting near!’’
